title: A sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on a qcqs scheme is a filtered colimit of constructible ones
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring, and let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda_X$-modules on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Then $F$ is a filtered colimit of constructible sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]: there are a small filtered category $\mathcal A$, a diagram $\alpha\mapsto F_\alpha$ from $\mathcal A$ to $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ with every $F_\alpha$ constructible, and morphisms $a_\alpha:F_\alpha\to F$ of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules forming a colimit cocone $(F,(a_\alpha)_\alpha)$ of the diagram in $\Mod(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. (Stacks states this for any Noetherian ring $\Lambda$; it is stated here for finite $\Lambda$, the generality of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. The special case of $X$ of finite type over a field is [lem-kun-03sa].)
